decision_context: PERF-12 T2 (§52–§54, §88): representation for the shared runtime NativeRef slot lookup, chosen by measurement
conclusion: paged table ~3.4x-4.3x faster than HashMap on identical workloads; page size 10 vs 12 statistically identical on lookup cost, so PAGE_BITS=12 chosen for the smaller worst-case directory (262,144 entries = 2 MiB at PATH_ROOT_REF=0x4000_0001 vs 8 MiB at 10 bits)
adopted: NativeRefTable<PAGE_BITS=12> backing NativeViewRuntime.slots with HashMap-compatible surface and empty-page reclamation
